content:
With Apple’s most important annual product event—the September iPhone launch—just one month away, here’s a roundup of the new products expected to be unveiled based on the various rumours.

iPhone 18 Pro, Pro Max, and iPhone Ultra

This year’s flagship iPhone lineup is reportedly set to be the smallest in years—and also the most expensive.

The reason is that multiple signs indicate the standard iPhone 18 won’t arrive until early 2027, and the iPhone Air 2 is expected to be delayed alongside it.

Three new iPhones are therefore expected to launch next month:

  • iPhone 18 Pro: Major camera upgrades, new colours, a smaller Dynamic Island, and more
  • iPhone 18 Pro Max: All of the above upgrades, plus an even larger battery
  • iPhone Ultra: An entirely new design, and the first foldable iPhone

Analysts estimate the iPhone 18 Pro will start at around US$1,399, while the iPhone Ultra is expected to retail for approximately US$1,999. Hopefully Apple can deliver pricing lower than expected.

Apple Watch Ultra 4 and Series 12

New Apple Watch models arrive every September, and this year is expected to be no different.

Here are the two new Apple Watch models rumoured:

  • Apple Watch Ultra 4: New health sensors, a completely refreshed design, and more
  • Apple Watch Series 12: A more powerful SiP processor, brand-new health features

Details on these two new watches remain quite limited for now. This could mean this year’s changes are relatively modest—or simply that Apple is holding back plenty of surprises.

Wildcards: All-new AirPods Pro, Apple home products

iPhones and Apple Watches are almost certain to appear at the September event, but Apple may also use the occasion to launch other products.

The most likely candidates are new AirPods and Apple home products.

  • AirPods Pro with cameras: Cameras used to power AI features, with potential health or accessibility uses
  • All-new Apple TV 4K: A more powerful chip to support Apple Intelligence and Siri AI
  • HomePad/HomePod Touch: A HomePod with a screen, centred on Siri
  • HomePod mini 2: Support for Siri AI, a new chip, improved sound quality
  • HomePod 3: Support for Siri AI and a new chip, with other changes relatively limited
  • Apple security camera: A home surveillance camera that supports HomeKit Secure Video

Apple has plenty of other autumn products that could appear next month, such as a new OLED iPad mini, new MacBook Pro, and an Ultra model. However, these products are widely expected to be pushed back to October.

Which Apple product are you planning to pick up at the September event? Feel free to share your thoughts in the comments.
